Thank you for contributing to TransitOS. This agreement keeps the project

You grant the maintainer a perpetual, worldwide, royalty-free, irrevocable

- the [GNU AGPL-3.0](../LICENSE), or any later OSI-approved open-source license

- a commercial license, so the project can also be offered to organizations that

This dual-license grant is exactly what lets TransitOS stay free for everyone
while keeping a sustainable funding path.

## 3. The community version stays free

The maintainer promises that a free, open-source version of TransitOS will

Your contribution is provided "as is", without warranties or support obligations

## 6. Entity contributions

If you are contributing on behalf of your employer, your employer must have
authorized this contribution, and you accept the agreement on their behalf.

## 7. Note

This is a community template, not legal advice. For a specific commercial
transaction, the parties should obtain independent legal review.
